notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first ends at عبد الوهاب and عبد الأعلى, the second at يعقوب الدورقي; «جميعا عن ابن علية» and the names after it are written once, so they are the shared tail (rule 3)
«- واللفظ ليعقوب -» is an editor gloss and is left out
The father's request in the story is not the saying relayed: he is not a link; the Prophet is not a link
